baseline_models.focus_anchor: The double-object construction in ja'alna al-nahara ma'ashan anchors an assigned relation between the day and livelihood.
baseline_models.mechanism: Making something enter a state configures the light-open day as the means and arena by which life is sustained; daylight is functional provision, not merely elapsed time.

activation_trace.role: Turning something into a state supplies the predicative assignment that gives day a livelihood function.
Day opening with light supplies the bounded illuminated interval that carries the assigned function.
Means of living and livelihood supplies the provisions, effort, and arena by which life continues.

changed_reading.before: Daytime exists, and people happen to earn during it.
changed_reading.after: Daylight is deliberately configured as an operative means and arena through which life is maintained.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Ma'ashan is anchored in the focus root ع ي ش and can name life or its lived condition as well as livelihood.
baseline_models.mechanism: The predicate can characterize the illuminated day as a mode of lived existence, broadening the verse beyond income or labor to the condition in which waking life unfolds.

activation_trace.role: State-making lets ma'ashan characterize what the day has been made into.
The light-open day supplies the manifest phase in which this lived condition operates.
Life and lived condition expands ma'ash beyond earnings to the quality and mode of living itself.

changed_reading.before: Ma'ashan denotes economic work or income alone.
changed_reading.after: The day is made a condition of wakeful living, with livelihood as one part of a broader lived mode.

context_deltas.mechanism: Three consecutive acts of making assign sleep, night, and day complementary functions. Sleep cuts off activity, night covers it, and the light-open day restores the livelihood interval, so productive time is bounded by divinely assigned cessation rather than demanding uninterrupted labor.

activation_trace.role: State-making anchors livelihood as the function assigned to day.
The day opening with light supplies the active half of the alternation.
Livelihood supplies the activity and support resumed in the daytime phase.
The repeated state-making verb places sleep in the same designed functional series as day.
Literal sleep supplies the recurring suspension opposite daytime activity.
Cutting and removal makes the suspension a bounded interruption of work.
The second repeated state-making verb assigns night its paired function.
Night as daylight's dark opposite establishes the temporal alternation.
Covering by clothing gives the inactive phase enclosure and protection.

structural_cues: 78:9-11 form three consecutive wa-ja'alna clauses with matched object-predicate shapes.
Night immediately precedes day as its explicit temporal opposite.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rest, cutting, darkness, covering, repeated state-making, and daylight livelihood; I infer that cessation and cover enable renewed daytime activity. A live alternative is complementarity without a causal dependence.

changed_reading.before: The verse licenses a generic or continuous workday.
changed_reading.after: The day is the productive phase of a sustainable cycle whose divinely made rest and cover set limits on production.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prepared ground, constructed overhead, a radiant hot lamp, delivered pouring water, and plant emergence form a material life-support sequence around the focus. Daylight is one operating layer in this provision system, and ma'ash names ecological support as well as human earning.

activation_trace.role: State-making anchors day as an intentionally assigned subsystem.
Day opening with light supplies the illuminated operating interval.
Means of living lets the focus gather provisions and enabling conditions into livelihood.
Preparing and leveling supplies the habitable ground layer of the system.
Building by joining parts supplies the constructed overhead layer.
The luminous lamp supplies illumination to the life-support sequence.
Blazing heat and light supply energetic force rather than light alone.
Delivery downward supplies the movement that brings water into the system.
Water supplies the material input explicitly used for growth.
Pouring and outflow make the water an abundant moving input.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the productive result of the water.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies biological livelihood rather than human labor alone.

structural_cues: The focus sits inside the creation catalogue of 78:6-16, between prepared habitation and the lamp-water-growth sequence.
The purpose construction in 78:15 explicitly links the preceding water to bringing out grain and vegetation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies construction imagery and an explicit water-to-growth purpose link; I add the system-level arrow that situates daylight and the blazing lamp within that provision chain. A live alternative is a catalogue of signs without one integrated causal model.

changed_reading.before: Ma'ash is chiefly the human opportunity to work for income.
changed_reading.after: The day is an operating phase in a built ecological provision system that makes all livelihood materially possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordinary light-open day is assigned livelihood only within the present arrangement. The Day of separation initiates a contrary regime in which the sky opens, mountains are removed into mirage, and basic cooling and drink disappear, showing that the focus describes a contingent function rather than an intrinsic permanence.

activation_trace.role: Turning day into a state makes livelihood an assigned and therefore potentially bounded function.
The familiar day opening with light supplies the present temporal regime.
Livelihood supplies the ordinary support function later withdrawn or redistributed.
The event and severity of a day supplies a qualitatively different temporal regime.
Judgment that separates truth from falsehood supplies the decisive boundary between regimes.
The opening of what was closed supplies the loss of the sky's stable enclosure.
Removal and displacement supply the undoing of the formerly fixed mountains.
Mirage shining like water supplies the unstable appearance left after removal.
The denied coolness supplies withdrawal of a basic relief associated with viable living.
The denied taking of drink supplies withdrawal of ordinary sustenance.

structural_cues: The creation catalogue ends at 78:16 and pivots at 78:17 into repeated Day language and passive transformations.
The no-coolness and no-drink pair reverses the earlier water-and-growth provision sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the pivot, transformations, and deprivation; I infer that the later unmaking places a temporal limit on the focus's assigned livelihood function. A live alternative treats the later scene as a separate topic that does not qualify al-nahar.

changed_reading.before: Day's livelihood function is a stable feature of reality.
changed_reading.after: Daytime livelihood is a merciful but provisional assignment within an order that can be decisively replaced.

context_deltas.mechanism: Livelihood entails activity and output; the later chain of matching recompense, accounting, exhaustive enumeration, binding record, and what hands send ahead turns the daytime arena of production into an accountable arena whose outputs return to the actor.

activation_trace.role: The assigned state makes day an appointed arena rather than an accidental opportunity.
The manifest daylight interval supplies the temporal arena for visible action.
Subsistence effort supplies the productive human activity that can yield accountable output.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the return path from output to actor.
Counting and accounting supply the evaluative operation the deniers did not expect.
Exhaustive numerical enumeration supplies completeness to the accountability mechanism.
A written fixing that entails judgment supplies durable registration of the output.
Advancing something forward supplies the transfer of present action toward its later encounter.
What the two hands earn directly identifies embodied human production as the accountable output.

structural_cues: 78:26-30 clusters matching recompense, denied accounting, exhaustive enumeration, record, and increase.
78:40 closes the surah with each person confronting what the hands sent ahead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an act-record-recompense chain; I infer that daytime livelihood is one principal arena feeding that chain. A live alternative is that the accounting covers all conduct and has no special relation to economic or daytime activity.

changed_reading.before: The day is a resource for obtaining subsistence with no further consequence implied.
changed_reading.after: The day is also an appointed field of productive agency whose outputs can be recorded and returned to their maker.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later surah polarizes the quality of living into deprivation of coolness and drink on one side and rescue, enclosed gardens, fruit, and a brimful cup on the other. These opposed provision environments activate ma'ash as a lived condition, making the present day a general life-setting rather than an economic slot alone.

activation_trace.role: The light-open day supplies the present world's ordinary living interval.
Life and lived condition permits ma'ash to register the quality of existence, including good or straitened living.
The absence of coolness supplies one concrete dimension of a straitened lived condition.
The absence of drink supplies deprivation of a basic means of living.
Attainment of good and rescue supplies the transition to the opposed condition.
An enclosed garden supplies a protected and provision-rich living environment.
Grapes as cultivated fruit supply positive nourishment within that environment.
The cup together with its contents supplies drink positively restored.
Filling the cup to its top turns restored drink into abundance.

structural_cues: The paired negation of coolness and drink in 78:24 contrasts with the accumulating provision nouns of 78:31-34.
Both outcome blocks describe what is or is not available within a containing environment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two opposed provision environments; I infer that they retrospectively activate the focus branch of ع ي ش as quality of life. A live alternative is that the outcome scenes remain independent descriptions and do not broaden ma'ashan.

changed_reading.before: Ma'ashan identifies daytime earning without describing a condition of life.
changed_reading.after: The ordinary day is a present lived environment whose provisions become legible against later conditions of deprivation and abundance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus-final ma'ashan, a means or place of living, is answered near the close by ma'aban, a place of return, together with deliberate taking. The echo places daily livelihood on an outbound-and-return arc: daytime living supplies a temporary course, not the destination.

activation_trace.role: The assigned state makes the daytime function a situated stage rather than an absolute end.
The bounded daylight interval supplies the temporary temporal station.
Means and places of living make ma'ashan capable of spatial as well as economic resonance.
Taking or acquiring supplies deliberate adoption of a route beyond the present life-setting.
Return to a destination supplies the terminus that ma'ashan itself does not provide.

structural_cues: 78:11 ends with ma'ashan and 78:39 ends with ma'aban, two indefinite accusative ma- nouns.
The second term occurs in a directed taking-toward construction, making motion and destination explicit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the formal echo and the taking-toward-return construction; I infer an outbound-and-return arc connecting them. A live alternative is phonological and morphological echo without a direct semantic bridge.

changed_reading.before: Daytime livelihood is the settled destination of human activity.
changed_reading.after: Daytime livelihood is a temporary station and means of passage within a larger movement toward return.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because al-nahar directly selects the daylight branch, while river-cutting and widening are cross-branch images of the same root. It remains anchored in the focus word and gains contextual force from water pouring and hidden growth emerging; downstream prose should present it only as a hydraulic image-resonance, never as the lexical translation of al-nahar.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun al-nahar carries branch images of a river channel and an opening widened for flow alongside its direct daylight branch.

activation_trace.role: A river cutting earth with flowing water supplies the channel image within the focus root.
Opening and widening until flow becomes possible supplies the channel's enabling geometry.
Means of living supplies what figuratively moves through the opened channel.
Actual water gives the later sequence a material flow matching the focus-root image.
Pouring and outflow activate movement through the imagined channel.
Bringing growth out of concealment supplies the life-bearing result of that flow.

changed_reading.before: The day is a static container in which livelihood happens.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the day is an opened channel through which life-supporting energy, provision, and activity are made to flow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the stipulated reward branch belongs to nominal ju'l language and is form-distant from verbal ja'alna. It remains anchored in the focus root and becomes live beside later matching recompense and measured gift; downstream prose should mark it as an economic resonance, not claim that ja'alna means paying a wage here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root ج ع ل includes a branch for a stipulated reward assigned for work, adjacent to ma'ashan as livelihood.

activation_trace.role: A stipulated reward for work supplies the form-distant commission or wage image.
Livelihood and subsistence effort give the commission image a work-related focus anchor.
Recompense answering an act supplies the later compensation structure.
A measure equal to need or counterpart supplies exact matching within that compensation.
Giving and handing over supplies the contrasting gift side of the economy.
Counting and reckoning keep measure active even in the gift description.

changed_reading.before: The day is simply scheduled for subsistence activity.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it resembles a commissioned work interval placed inside a wider economy of action, matching recompense, and gift.

strongest_changes: The sleep-night-day sequence bounds livelihood with designed cessation and cover, so the verse describes sustainable alternation rather than nonstop production.
The prepared-earth and lamp-water-growth sequence expands ma'ash from employment to an ecological life-support system.
The Day of separation and the record-recompense chain make the present daylight order both provisional and ethically productive.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet let the focus remain at once temporal, ecological, ethical, and spatial without forcing one final gloss. Early provision, later reversal, final accounting, and the ma'ashan-ma'aban echo activated different mechanisms; hydraulic and wage-like branch resonances remain explicitly contained as outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet explicitly links water to growth, but the causal integration of daylight and the blazing lamp into one ecological system remains reader-supplied.
Ma'ashan may foreground means of livelihood, a place or interval of subsistence, or the broader condition of living; the focus alone does not force one scope.
The ordinary-day versus final-Day contrast is conceptual because the packet uses roots ن ه ر and ي و م rather than repeating one root.
The hydraulic, commissioned-reward, and livelihood-to-return readings depend on branch distance or formal echo and should remain exploratory.
